rows.definition: Prompt-assembly layout: stable prefix of reused views plus volatile tail of raw faults
rows.distinction: Prompt-assembly layout - NOT RenderItem (one cell materialized)

rows.definition: One cell materialized into context by OpRender query effect
rows.distinction: One cell materialized by OpRender - NOT RenderPlan (whole layout)

rows.definition: One span paged into fresh history through the trust gate
rows.distinction: Span paged through trust gate - NOT RenderItem (memq effect)

rows.definition: Context-scoped source snapshot provider used by native execution verification to lease an independently pinned, clean full repository snapshot and release it after selectors finish.
rows.distinction: Acquires source files for execution witnesses, distinct from RenderPlan prompt assembly, RenderItem context cells, and Rendered history spans. The provider does not change selector verdicts or source refs; provider errors remain verification errors.
